facts.fact: The government, through regulator INCM, and operators launched a rural connectivity pilot under 'Internet for All by 2030' on 28 April 2025 in Xinavane; two satellite-backed antennas are installed, in Xinavane and Pessene, each able to reach around 15,000 people.
facts.system: Internet for All by 2030 rural pilot

systems.owner: INCM with BDQ Mobile, Movitel, VANU and Spacecom
